_readme: Single source of truth for business facts. Edit here; every page, the footer and the schema update on the next build. Empty strings / null = not confirmed yet (the site hides them or shows a dev-only TODO note in preview mode).
name: LaCaze Roadside Assistance
tagline: Fast. Reliable. Mobile. We come to you.
smsBody: Hi, I need roadside help. My location is:
serviceAreaLabel: Spring, Klein, The Woodlands, Tomball, Magnolia, Conroe, Cypress, Humble, Aldine, Porter, North Houston and surrounding areas
_todo_arrival: Average arrival time in minutes, e.g. 30. Leave null until John confirms.
_todo_prices: Starting prices in dollars, e.g. 65. Leave null until John confirms.
_todo_google: Paste the Google Business Profile / Google Maps share link (e.g. https://maps.app.goo.gl/...) once confirmed.
_social: Only add a URL once it is verified as John's official profile. Empty = hidden.
_analytics: GA4 measurement ID (G-XXXXXXX) and Google Search Console verification token. Empty = not loaded.
_reviews: Copied word for word from Google review screenshots in assets-src/reviews/. Do not edit the text. Reviews with no written text show the star rating and price assessment only.

reviews.name: Ashley B.
reviews.text: My husband was out of town and my teenager locked us out of the car at night.  It was me and my two kids.  I ordered roadside assistance through my insurance app and the app said my wait time was 3 hours but he came in 45 minutes.  Was respectful, fast, and easy.  Would use anytime.

reviews.name: Dominique C.
reviews.text: I was on the side of the road!!! I was trying to get to the nearest gas station but ended up running out of gas right off the freeway😩. I didn’t want to be on the side of the road long. they came quick! Within 30 minutes or less! Very courteous and it even eased my nerves a bit! I was so grateful! Thank you so much!!! Life saver, will definitely use them again if I need to and recommend 10 out of 10 over all service!!
